_source: Recorded 2026-10-20 from FMC 10.0.1 (build 1), domain Global/mcp-test-leaf (Wave 6 probe): POST devices/devicerecords/operational/bulkcommands -> 403 (feature flag off), and the per-device GET devicerecords/{id}/operational/commands?command=show version for a connected FTD (200) and an unreachable one (500). Device name, UUID, serial and MAC addresses replaced with documentation values; links dropped. `bulk_task_schema` is NOT recorded: it is built from the FMC 10.0.1 schema (BulkCommand metadata.task + TaskStatus subTasks) until an FMC with bulk_device_command_execution on answers.

concurrent_mixup._source: Recorded live 2026-10-21 (Wave 6 Stage 2), FMC 10.0.1 (build 1), Global/mcp-test-leaf: bulkcommands refused (403), so fmc_run_show_command ran per device with eight GET devicerecords/{id}/operational/commands at once. FMC answered concurrent requests with ANOTHER device's output: the 'show version' banner and its 'UUID : <id>' line named a different device than the request path, and every run gave a different mix; single, sequential requests were right. Devices renamed (the SD-WAN hub and spokes of lab t1, two standalone FTDs), UUIDs replaced with documentation values, addresses mapped to 192.0.2.x/28 like device_snapshot_t1.json (spoke1 = that recording's device). `answered_with` maps each requested device to the device whose output FMC returned.
